# Vidrey's Report briefing

Client-facing deck for the London Digital Twin, branded
**Vidrey's Report — Independent Audit for Brands**. Generated by
`scripts/generate-briefing.mjs`; never hand-edited as a PDF.

## Outputs

```text
docs/briefing/vidreys-report_london-digital-twin_YYYY-MM-DD.pdf              14 slides, A4 landscape
docs/briefing/vidreys-report_london-digital-twin-operational_YYYY-MM-DD.pdf  /report export, A4 portrait
```

The date is the London calendar date at generation. The HTML source is written
to the system temp directory, not committed: it contains ~120 KB of base64
fonts.

## Commands

```bash
npm run briefing                     # deck + operational report
npm run briefing -- --deck-only      # deck only
npm run briefing -- --report-only    # /report only (needs the deployed brand line)
npm run briefing -- --verify         # deck + per-slide overflow audit and screenshots
npm run briefing -- --api <url> --supabase-url <url> --anon-key <key>
```

Requirements: Microsoft Edge or Chrome. If it is not in a standard path, set
`EDGE_PATH` (or `CHROME_PATH`). No extra npm dependencies are used.

## Data collection

- Public API (no Origin header): `/network/status`, `/dashboard/summary`,
  `/dashboard/history?hours=24`, `/lines`, `/disruptions`,
  `/analytics/network`, `/analytics/footfall/summary?days=30&limit=8`,
  `/analytics/annual/summary?limit=8`, `/analytics/boardings`, `/data-health`.
- Row counts: PostgREST with the **public anon key** and
  `Prefer: count=exact`, read from RLS-public tables. `service_role` is not used
  and no secret is required.
- Counted tables: `lines`, `stations`, `line_stations`, `line_paths`,
  `station_entrances`, `line_status_snapshots`, `disruptions`,
  `line_annual_boardings`, and `station_traffic_snapshots` /
  `station_crowding_profiles` filtered by `source_dataset` or `kind`.
- `network_status_hourly` is not readable by `anon` (service-role grant only);
  history comes from `/dashboard/history` instead.

Every slide carries the generation timestamp; historical datasets keep their
source year. Missing values render as `—`, never as an estimate.

## Pipeline

```text
API + count(*) (in memory)  →  model  →  HTML (fonts embedded, print CSS)
  →  Edge --headless=new --print-to-pdf  →  assert %PDF-, size, page count
  →  optional CDP audit: scrollHeight vs clientHeight per slide + screenshots
```

`--verify` starts Edge with `--remote-debugging-port=9333`, measures every
`.slide` at 1122×794 and fails when content exceeds the page. Screenshots go to
`%TEMP%/vidreys-screens-YYYY-MM-DD/slide-NN.png`.

The operational report is printed through CDP `Page.printToPDF` after polling
until `.print-report` has table rows and no “aguarda sync” text.

## Brand system

| Token | Value | Use |
|---|---|---|
| Wordmark | `VIDREY'S REPORT` | cover and running header |
| Tagline | `Independent Audit for Brands` | cover and header |
| navy-950 | `#0A1523` | cover |
| navy-900 | `#0E1B2C` | header text, table rules |
| brass-500 | `#C9A227` | rules and accents |
| brass-300 | `#E3C766` | tagline on navy |
| ink | `#14202E` | body text |
| muted | `#5A6B7C` | secondary text |
| rule | `#D8DEE6` | table lines |

Typography is Inter (400/500/600/700) fetched from Google Fonts and embedded as
base64 woff2 at generation time. If the download fails the deck falls back to
`Segoe UI`; the PDF is still valid but the type changes.

Legal line, present on the cover, every footer and the last slide:
“Independent report prepared by Vidrey's Report. Not affiliated with, endorsed or
sponsored by Transport for London.”

## Slides

1. Cover
2. Scope and method
3. Network at a glance
4. Live operations
5. Line-by-line status
6. Active disruptions
7. Last 24 hours
8. Footfall and annual demand
9. Capacity, loadings and boardings
10. Topology and single points of failure
11. Sources, jobs and retention
12. Architecture
13. Audit findings
14. Sources, licences and disclaimer

Adding or removing a slide requires updating `TOTAL_SLIDES` in
`scripts/generate-briefing.mjs`; the generator asserts the PDF page count.

## Pitfalls

- The `/report` PDF includes the print-only Vidrey's Report block in
  `ReportPage.tsx`, which is `hidden print:block`. Generate it only **after** the
  Pages deploy that contains it.
- `/report` is a GitHub Pages deep link: it returns HTTP 404 with the SPA HTML
  and still renders. Wait for table rows before printing.
- Source status values are snake_case (`not_synced`); map them for display.
- Disruption records contain duplicates of the same alert; the deck collapses
  them by line + band + description and says so in the table note.
- The `elizabeth` line uses mode `elizabeth-line`; keep both keys mapped.
- Never embed the Supabase access token, database password or service_role key.
  The generator asserts that the anon key does not leak into the HTML.
- PDFs are committed in `docs/briefing/`; regenerate rather than editing them.
